questions.text: Why are signal widths important in synthesis?
options: Wider signals always use less area.
They affect represented values, truncation and the amount of arithmetic hardware.
They affect only source-code file size.

questions.text: What happens to a constant false branch during ordinary optimization?
options: It must occupy the same area as the whole design.
It can be removed if it has no required observable effect.
It becomes a new input clock.
It is converted into a package pin.

questions.text: Why can a statically bounded for loop in synthesizable RTL describe parallel hardware?
options: Every loop iteration must execute on an embedded CPU.
The source keyword for directly sets clock frequency.
RTL loops always consume one clock cycle per iteration.
Elaboration or synthesis can expand the iterations into structural operations.

questions.text: What is the output of synthesizing a combinational constant assignment y=1'b0, subject to normal technology implementation?
options: A constant-zero connection, potentially using a tie cell.

questions.text: Which transformation is constant propagation?
options: Replacing expressions whose operands are known constants with their computed values.
Moving a standard cell to a new coordinate.
Adding clock buffers at every input.

options: A term that must cover every OFF-set point.

questions.text: What makes an implicant prime?
options: It cannot be expanded further by removing a literal without covering an OFF-set point.
It contains a prime number of variables.
It is always the only valid implementation.
It covers exactly one minterm in every function.

questions.text: What makes a prime implicant essential?
options: It has the longest source-code expression.
It contains every variable in the function.
It covers at least one ON-set minterm covered by no other prime implicant.

questions.text: What is the role of a don't-care condition in minimization?
options: It permits wrong behavior on all specified ON-set points.
Its output may be chosen to simplify implementation within the stated specification.
It automatically means the input can never occur physically.
It must always be implemented as an unknown voltage.

questions.text: What must a valid SOP cover include?
options: Every required ON-set assignment while avoiding required OFF-set assignments.
Exactly one term regardless of the function.

questions.text: What is a literal?
options: Only a decimal constant larger than one.
A variable or its complement appearing in an expression.

What is a typical limitation of heuristic logic minimization?
options: It applies only after chip packaging.
It requires every input assignment to be an OFF-set point.
It need not guarantee a globally minimum cover for every problem.
It can never reduce an expression.

questions.text: What does logic equivalence preservation require?
options: The transformed circuit matches the required behavior over the specified domain.
All physical wires must retain identical lengths.
Every internal signal must retain its old name.
The source text must remain character-for-character identical.

questions.text: Why can two equivalent Boolean expressions have different implementation quality?
options: Equivalence requires exactly the same cell area.
All equivalent expressions must have identical power.
Library choices, fanout, depth and interconnect can differ.
The truth table determines every physical coordinate uniquely.

questions.text: What often improves when a deep logic chain is restructured into a shallower balanced tree?
options: The number of logic levels on long paths can decrease.
The need to preserve functionality disappears.
Every input capacitance necessarily becomes zero.

An 8-input reduction built as a serial chain of two-input gates has how many gate levels?
Which optimization can remove logic that cannot influence any required output or state?
Why should simulation models used as references handle reset and unknown values deliberately?
options: Unknown values are automatically identical to zero in every operator.
Initialization and four-state behavior can affect the comparison.
Reset is only a packaging property.

questions.text: Which construct is generally a testbench timing control rather than portable ASIC synthesizable RTL?
options: A procedural # delay used to model elapsed simulation time.

questions.text: Why can division by a known power of two simplify for unsigned arithmetic?
options: It changes unsigned addition into subtraction.
It can map to a right shift with appropriate width semantics.
It must add an extra clock domain.
It always requires a floating-point CPU.

questions.text: What does a coverage-analysis tool add to a simulation workflow?
options: Measurements of which modeled structures or conditions the tests exercised.
A proof that no functional requirement was omitted.

questions.text: Why must the testbench and DUT port connections be checked?
options: Every simulator repairs mismatched connections automatically.
Port names are never used during elaboration.
A correct test algorithm can still drive or observe the wrong signal.
Inputs and outputs are interchangeable without consequences.

questions.text: What can happen if a combinational sensitivity list omits an input read by the block?
options: Every gate doubles in physical size.
The omitted input becomes an ideal clock.
Simulation may fail to update when that input changes.

questions.text: What does always @* help express in traditional Verilog?
options: A block that executes only at the first clock edge.
A combinational sensitivity set inferred from referenced signals.

questions.text: What is a priority structure in an if/else-if chain?
options: Earlier satisfied conditions take precedence over later ones.
The last condition always wins regardless of earlier conditions.
All conditions are ignored after synthesis.

questions.text: For a two-input mux y=sel?a:b, what input determines y when sel=0?
options: The old value of y necessarily
